changeinfo.changes:
List of Updates

Content added

    The addition of "Additional Pacts X"
  • New quests, Additional Pacts X, can be found in: Mad Chronicle -> Sorcerous Deeds -> Pacts -> Additional Pacts

Additional Features

    The Addition of New Raiment
  • New raiment has been added to your wardrobe in the Portraiture menu.
    You can select these new garments from: Portraiture -> Appearance -> Raiment -> Raiment: Top/Raiment: Bottom.
    ・Gravity Girl
    ・Slave
    ・White Cat
    New Complete Victory Reward added
  • The following accessories have been added as Complete Victory Rewards for blank pages. Please note these rewards will only appear on quests of Extreme difficulty.
    ・Old Hero Helm
    New Clothes for the Season
  • New raiment to obtain can be found in Bazaar Ledger -> Carnatux the Merchant -> Buy Raiment.
    New Functionality Added to Blank Pages
  • It is now easy to distinguish whether each page's Complete Victory Reward has or has not been acquired.

Bug fixes.

  • Other small bug fixes.

List of Updates

Content added

    New Episode: "The Reaper's Gloom" Added
  • New episode, "The Reaper's Gloom" can be found in: Mad Chronicle -> Sorcerous Deeds -> Avalon.
    The Addition of "Additional Pacts VI"
  • New quests, Additional Pacts VI, can be found in: Mad Chronicle -> Sorcerous Deeds -> Pacts -> Additional Pacts
    The Addition of the Archfiend Bahamut
  • New archfiends, Bahamuts, have been added to the game.
    Bahamuts are rare creatures which have a small chance of appearing during archfiend-slaying quests. (Though they won't appear at all in certain levels.)
    Though not the target of pacts, by defeating a Bahamut experience points gained through subjugating archfiends will be greatly boosted.
    You may exchange soul and life essences gained by defeating Bahamuts for special rumours.

Additional Features

    The Addition of New Raiment
  • New raiment has been added to your wardrobe in the Portraiture menu.
    You can select these new garments from: Portraiture -> Appearance -> Raiment -> Raiment: Top/Raiment: Bottom.
    ・Knight Blazer
    ・Lady Harken
    ・Drifter
    New Functionality Added to Blank Pages
  • New accessories have been added as Complete Victory Rewards for Blank Pages.
    ・Hanpan
    ・Liz Mask
    ・Hayokonton Mask
    ・Siegfried Mask
    ・Berserk Mask
    ・Alhazad Mask
    ・Asgard's Helm
    New Functionality Added to Rite of Transmutation
  • Warning text now appears if you try to perform a Rite of Transmutation when already in possession of the maximum number of rumours.
    New Functionality Added to Aurex the Whisperer
  • The number of rumours in your possession, as well as the maximum you are able to carry are now displayed at the Rumour Board found in the Aurex the Whisperer menu.
    New Functionality Added to Blank Pages
  • You can now check the Complete Victory Reward for various pacts from the table of contents.
    Completed pacts will be marked as cleared with a stamp.
    New Functionality Added to Multiplayer
  • Entered text is now easy to distinguish as finalised or un-finalised before submission when using free text input in room chat.

Changed Features

    Functionality Changes in Multiplayer
  • Improved cursor visibility when entering a room name during room searches.
    Spell balance adjustments
  • Some spells have undergone balance adjustments.

Bug fixes.

  • Other small bug fixes.

List of Updates

"Alice's Eternal Maze" Added

  • A new quest, "Alice's Eternal Maze", has been added.

Content added

    New Episode: "A Voice Lost" Added
  • New episode, "A Voice Lost" can be found in: Mad Chronicle -> Sorcerous Deeds -> Grim.
    The Addition of "Additional Pacts IV"
  • New quests, Additional Pacts IV can be found in: Mad Chronicle -> Sorcerous Deeds -> Pacts -> Additional Pacts

Additional Features

    New Blank Page Rewards
  • New accessories can be obtained through blank pages.
  • New voices can be obtained through blank pages.
    Additional Functionality in Multiplayer Rooms
  • You can now check the particulars of the currently selected quest while in a multiplayer room.
    New Functionality for Logging Slayer Points
  • You can now earn new Titles by submitting a set number of Slayer Points, found in Bazaar Ledger -> Faction Power Balance -> Log Slayer Pts.
    New Functionality for Rumour Board
  • Filtering has been improved for the list of notes collected in Bazaar Ledger -> Aurex the Whisperer -> Rumour Board.
    New Clothes for the Season
  • New raiment to obtain can be found in Bazaar Ledger -> Carnatux the Merchant -> Buy Raiment.
    New Functionality for Choosing Allies
  • You can now filter by faction in Portraiture -> Allies. On top of this, you can also transfer multiple offerings to an ally at once now.

Bug fixes.

  • Other small bug fixes.
